name: DoorLoop
shortDescription: Property management for rent, leasing, and maintenance. One starts at a $199 monthly minimum.
longDescription: DoorLoop's One plan is $2.50 per unit per month with a $199 monthly minimum, and $1.50 per unit after 100 units. Connect is $4 per unit per month with a $299 minimum, and Multiply is $5 per unit per month with a $399 minimum. The One plan includes an AI assistant for listings, summaries, and inspection reports, along with accounting, leasing, maintenance, and rent collection. Tenant screening is $35 on every plan.
pricingNotes: One is $2.50 per unit per month ($1.50 per unit above 100) with a $199 monthly minimum. Connect is $4 per unit with a $299 minimum. Multiply is $5 per unit with a $399 minimum. The One plan includes an AI assistant, accounting, leasing, maintenance, and rent collection. Tenant screening is $35 on every plan. No trial length is shown.
bestFor: Rent collection, leasing, and maintenance with an assistant on the One plan
notIdealFor: A landlord who wants a plan below the $199 monthly minimum
strength: DoorLoop's One plan includes an AI assistant for listings, summaries, and inspection reports, plus rent collection, leasing, and maintenance.
weakness: The One plan has a $199 monthly minimum, tenant screening is $35 on every plan, and no trial length is shown.

useCaseFit.property-management: Tracks rent, maintenance, and leases and includes an assistant for tenant questions.
